# DropSpace v0.3.0-beta.29

<!-- update-summary: Beta 29 fixes shutdown and cancellation races, native OLE and clipboard ownership, transfer/share cleanup, storage confinement, and verified update/release handling after three full-project audit rounds. -->

## Fixed

- Prevent queued UI callbacks and shell acknowledgements from accessing disposed state; preserve batch drag contents, projection, concurrent settings and accurate transfer status.
- Contain native tray and drag callback failures, preserve the supplying OLE apartment during failed virtual-file cleanup, and honor caller cancellation during storage and thumbnail operations.
- Correct clipboard overflow accounting, retry and self-write suppression, Windows Share bitmap extensions, malformed NetEase installation scanning, and credential redaction.
- Harden authenticated transfer routing, pairing cancellation, finalization, terminal-session retention, DNS announcements and persistent cleanup/rollback.
- Preserve source files while enforcing staging, payload, preview and update-cache containment; repair Unicode search, image/text parsing and disabled logging behavior.
- Make encrypted share upload reservations and cleanup safe under retries and competing requests; validate release versions, official assets, exact checksums and installer argument boundaries.
- Consolidate proven duplicate implementations and align current product/privacy documentation with the shipped behavior while retaining historical records.

## Validation

The three-round source audit and executed portable evidence are recorded in
`docs/audit/2026-09-30/full-project-three-round-audit.md`. Those Linux results do not
establish Windows DPAPI, WinUI or packaging acceptance. This release requires both
language Windows CI jobs and the real Windows release-validation bundle to pass on
the exact release candidate, including DPAPI and App tests, WinUI, Portable EXE,
installer lifecycle, MSIX/identity packaging, executable versions and final
SHA-256/update-manifest checks. Publication also requires the critical manual
candidate evidence in `TEST_PLAN.md`, including the documented two-device and
operator-deployed Worker network acceptance. Publication remains disabled until
all required gates pass; pending evidence is not a passing result.

Beta 28 is the upgrade baseline; existing data and settings remain supported.
Physical OS/DPI/multi-monitor/provider and deployed network/Worker acceptance need
their own evidence; hosted CI does not establish those behaviors. Candidate
evidence is pending, so this file is release preparation rather than a published
or fully validated release claim.
